j2me_emulator.what: Minimal J2ME (MIDP lcdui/rms/media stubs over AWT) runtime that executes the ORIGINAL NinjaSchool1.jar bytecode headless, with scripted key input, screenshots, static-field dumps and text capture. Class a/Midlet patched only in a copy (emu/pcls) so Class.getResourceAsStream routes to the classpath (Java9+ module issue); raw JAR untouched.
j2me_emulator.run: analysis/claude/emu/run.sh <outdir> < script  (commands: wait ms | tap key [n] | hold key ms | press/release key | shot name | dump name | vars f1 f2 | set f v | call method args | texts name)
j2me_emulator.verified: boots, sound/quality prompts, title menu, New Game map99 intro cutscene (gate + principal dialogue) rendered identically to original assets

transpiler.what: CFR a.java+Midlet.java -> game/core/orig.gd (all structured methods incl. draw routines); javap bytecode of a.run()/a.paint() -> game/core/orig_run.gd state machines. Rebuild: tools/transpile/build.sh
transpiler.status: 0 translation errors; parses and runs in Godot 4.7.2

godot_game.what: Godot project: core (original logic, 25Hz), render/cmd_renderer (draw commands, 60fps interpolation, HD replacement by routine tag), render/hd_world, render/overlay (new HUD/particles), ui/controls (remap)
godot_game.status: boots -> New Game -> map99 intro cutscene plays; trace vs emulator lockstep: 185/191 frames identical (diffs = camera ±1px during loader timing)
